notes: ACCESS: hsn.com is behind Akamai Bot Manager. A direct curl_cffi fetch of https://www.hsn.com/shop/bath/ho0469 returned HTTP 200 carrying only a ~7KB Akamai sensor interstitial with no product grid (verified this session, same as the Furniture pass). WORKING ROUTE (identical to the Furniture and Home-Decor passes): https://www-hsn-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=<lang>&_x_tr_hl=en, which returns genuine server-rendered origin HTML (~1.27MB per listing). It 429s under load; a rotating _x_tr_tl target language (es/fr/de/it/pt/nl/sv/da/pl/ro) plus backoff cleared it every time. Every `link` recorded is a canonical www.hsn.com origin URL, never a proxy URL. ROBOTS: fetched FIRST (https://www.hsn.com/robots.txt, 593 bytes). It has exactly two groups - 'User-agent: *' and 'User-agent: bingbot' (Crawl-delay: 1). There is NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive at all, so no Claude exclusion exists. The '*' group disallows /account, /Ajax/profile, /profile, /checkout, /com, /cust, /facebook/like, /myaccount, two product URLs, /search, /search-more-products, /show-more-products/, /smgen.aspx and /bonusbuy/PromotionProducts/ - it does NOT disallow /shop/ or /sitemap. The disallowed /search and /show-more-products/ endpoints were deliberately not used at any point. TREE SOURCE: https://www.hsn.com/sitemap (the sitemap index) is served unprotected on a plain direct fetch and lists 14 department sitemaps; /sitemap/ho?name=home returned all 367 Home locs, which were listed in full and read end-to-end (not just grepped) so no bathroom node could hide behind a non-obvious slug. The tree was then confirmed on the live pages: Home > Bath is ho0469 (/shop/bath/ho0469, 110 items, schema.org BreadcrumbList = Home > Bath) and its own left-nav 'Departments' filter group enumerates exactly nine children with per-child counts - Accessories ho0470 (8), Bathroom Hardware ho0476 (6), Beach Towels ho0657 (1), Furniture ho0471 (30), Mirrors ho0477 (16), Rugs & Mats ho0474 (15), Shower Curtains ho0475 (16), Sleepwear & Robes ho0538 (4), Towels ho0473 (16). Each of those child pages was then opened individually; every one returns the Bath SIBLING set in its own Departments facet rather than a fresh child set, which is HSN's signature for a terminal node - so the Bath children are the deepest listing grids and there is no level-4 under Bath. QTY SOURCE: each listing page carries data-total-products="N" on the product-grid div (id=template-product-grid), duplicated as data-cnstrc-num-results="N" (HSN runs Constructor.io). VERIFICATION, four independent ways: (1) data-total-products equals data-cnstrc-num-results on every page read; (2) it equals the count the PARENT Bath page's own Departments facet publishes for that child, on all seven Bath children that have their own page - 8=8, 6=6, 30=30, 16=16, 15=15, 16=16, 16=16 - i.e. two structurally different parts of the rendered page agree; (3) the number of distinct /products/ tiles actually delivered in the HTML equals the total on every node at or under the 60-per-page limit (Accessories 8=8, Hardware 6=6, Mirrors 16=16, Rugs & Mats 15=15, Shower Curtains 16=16, Towels 16=16) - a genuine single-page exhaustion check - while Bath itself (110) and Decor > Mirrors (96) correctly show 60 tiles on page 1; (4) all three emitted leaves were re-read in a second forced pass (cache bypassed, different target language) and returned 8, 6 and 16 again, with Bath still 110 - no drift. Counts discriminate (1 to 110), they are not a site-wide constant, and every page's schema.org breadcrumb was checked to match the node requested. DEDUP: lib/dedup.already_extracted() was run on all 16 candidate/adjacent URLs. FOUR hits, all from Furniture.xlsx for HSN Home - Bath > Furniture ho0471 'Bathroom Furniture' (30), and the Furniture-department trio Bathroom Shelves ho0142 (4), Bathroom Stools ho0141 (14), Bathroom Vanities ho0143 (1). Under the run-owner OPTION 1 policy these stay in Furniture and are recorded in `review`, not `rows`, even though rules 9 and 12 would otherwise class them as Bathroom. EXCLUDED AND WHY: /shop/bath/ho0469 (110) is the parent and is never recorded while valid children exist (rule 24); /shop/bathroom-furniture/ho0138 (19) is the Furniture-department parent whose three children are all already-extracted, so it is barred both by rule 24 and by the dedup policy. HSN sells no toilets, basins, baths, taps or shower enclosures - the only shower items on the site are showerhead filters and showerheads, which sit inside the recorded Bathroom Hardware leaf. No bathroom LIGHTING node exists in the Home tree (wall-lights/ho0079 and ceiling-lighting/ho0077 are general Lighting, not bathroom-specific), so nothing was routed to Lighting. NET RESULT: 3 Bathroom leaves totalling 30 products, with 11 findings preserved in review.
